title: Generalize VcsHistory/ProtocolList Surfaces to GraphTimeline/BlockList
description: Rename the app-named SurfaceKind variants VcsHistory -> GraphTimeline (wire "vcs-history" -> "graph-timeline") and ProtocolList -> BlockList (wire "protocol-list" -> "block-list") across ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, framework/core/js/index.ts, framework/renderer/react/ui-interpreter.tsx (+ dedicated host component file rename), framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, and any call sites in the owning app's plugin crate. Also generalize scene struct/type names (VcsHistoryScene/HistoryColumn -> GraphTimelineScene/HistoryColumn as needed; ProtocolListScene/ProtocolPaletteEntry -> BlockListScene/BlockPaletteEntry). Pure rename + minor data-driven generalization, part of a sequential surface-generalization series.
summary: Found this ticket already open with most of the VcsHistory/ProtocolList -> GraphTimeline/BlockList rename already landed by a prior session (ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, framework/core/js/index.ts, framework/renderer/react/ui-interpreter.tsx + graph-timeline-host.tsx/block-list-host.tsx, framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, os-shell.tsx, vcs/plugin/rs/lib.rs, protocol/plugin/rs/lib.rs, forms/plugin/rs/lib.rs, protocol/rs/lib.rs, ui/js/react/index.tsx labels were all already consistent with the new names). Repo-wide grep found two compile-breaking stragglers still using the old UiComponentSceneNode field names (vcs_history/protocol_list) that no longer exist on the struct (which already has graph_timeline/block_list): mathematical/plugin/rs/lib.rs's empty_component_scene() and infinite/world/rs/lib.rs's test-only scene_with_selection() helper. Fixed both by renaming the two struct-literal fields to graph_timeline/block_list (infinite/world/rs/lib.rs was also missing the second field entirely, added it). Left vcs/plugin/rs/lib.rs's own VCS_PLAY_WINDOW_HISTORY = "vcs-history" window-id constant and protocol app's build_protocol_list_scene()/test-name vocabulary untouched since those are app-owned identifiers, not the framework SurfaceKind wire name, and don't violate framework purity.
